Attention Is All You Need.

The research paper that changed the world.

Published by Google researchers in 2017, it introduced the Transformer architecture and proved that AI could understand relationships in text using attention, without relying on RNNs or LSTMs.

Today, almost every major language model, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama and many others, is built on ideas that came from this paper.

A few fun facts:
• It has been cited hundreds of thousands of times, making it one of the most influential AI papers ever.
• The paper had 8 authors, often called the “Transformer Eight.”
• The famous title almost sounds like a Beatles reference: All You Need Is Love.
• The original model was trained to translate between languages, but the same architecture ended up powering modern generative AI.

Sometimes, one paper doesn’t just improve a field.
